title: Evaluate a prefix expression
prompt: The input is an arithmetic expression in prefix (Polish) notation, given as a list of tokens. A token is "+", "-" or "*", or an integer written in decimal digits without a sign. An expression is either a single integer token, or an operator token followed by two expressions (its left and right operands); "-" subtracts the right operand from the left. The input is always exactly one well-formed expression with no tokens left over. Return its value.
